about_the_game:
This delicious Soundtrack contains 10 juicy tracks prepared with care,  from the world of Jamboy! Enjoy your meal!

"First of all, thank you for taking the time to listen. I hope the Jamboy soundtrack leaves a mark on you and inspires you to return to the game again and again.

Maybe it's a bit vain to aim for such a thing, since I can barely count on my fingers the soundtracks that ever did that to me — and it's those very ones that inspired me to venture into this wonderful world. But if even just one of you feels something remotely similar, my work will be more than fulfilled. I also hope my music does justice to the game, and that it has managed to represent well its wacky and cartoonish style.

Thanks again for playing Jamboy and for your interest in my music — it truly means the world to me."

- Santi Castillo
